ABOUT.LIBELLE: Mr Fix Repair is a company that repairs and sells electronic and computer equipment.
ABOUT.ONE: Mr Fix is ​a company specializing in the maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of electronic and IT equipment, offering reliable and sustainable solutions to both individuals and businesses. We service a wide range of equipment—computers, peripherals, IT systems, and electronic devices—while also selling high-quality electronic and IT equipment, carefully selected to meet the highest standards of performance, security, and longevity. With proven technical expertise, responsive customer service, and a constant commitment to excellence, Mr Fix supports its clients in optimizing, securing, and ensuring the long-term viability of their technological infrastructures.

TWO.CARD_CONTENT: Our qualified technicians provide accurate diagnosis and effective interventions on your electronic and IT equipment, regardless of its complexity.

THREE.CARD_CONTENT: We use reliable components and proven methods to ensure durable repairs and high-performing equipment over the long term.

FOUR.CARD_CONTENT: We place customer satisfaction at the heart of our commitment through attentive listening, controlled deadlines and personalized support.

DATA_RECOVERY.ABOUT_TEXT: At Mr Fix Electronics, we specialize in recovering lost, deleted, or damaged data from various storage devices. Whether your device is not detected, corrupted, or accidentally formatted, we use professional tools and proven methods to recover your important files safely.
DATA_RECOVERY.WHAT_SUBTITLE: Recovery from all types of storage devices
DATA_RECOVERY.DEVICE_HDD_DESC: Internal and external drives, lost partitions, bad sectors.
DATA_RECOVERY.DEVICE_SSD_DESC: SATA SSD, NVMe, formatted or undetected drives.
DATA_RECOVERY.DEVICE_USB_DESC: Damaged, corrupted or accidentally formatted USB drives.
DATA_RECOVERY.DEVICE_SD_DESC: SD cards, microSD for cameras, phones and drones.
DATA_RECOVERY.DEVICE_LAPTOP_DESC: Data recovery from any crashed or non-booting system.
DATA_RECOVERY.PROBLEM_2: Your drive is not detected by the computer
DATA_RECOVERY.PROBLEM_3: Your system crashed or won't boot
DATA_RECOVERY.PROBLEM_5: Your drive is slow or making unusual noise
DATA_RECOVERY.STEP_1_DESC: Bring your storage device to our shop in Yaoundé, Awae Escalier.
DATA_RECOVERY.STEP_2_DESC: We perform a full diagnosis (5,000 – 10,000 FCFA).
DATA_RECOVERY.STEP_3_DESC: We confirm if recovery is possible and provide the cost estimate.
DATA_RECOVERY.STEP_4_DESC: After your approval, we recover your data and return it to you.
DATA_RECOVERY.PRICING_TEXT: Recovery cost depends on the condition of the storage device.
DATA_RECOVERY.PRICING_NOTE: Final price is confirmed after diagnosis.
DATA_RECOVERY.CONFIDENTIALITY_TEXT: Your data is important and private. We handle all recovered files with strict confidentiality. Your information is never shared or accessed without your explicit permission.
DATA_RECOVERY.CTA_TITLE: Don't wait — damaged drives can get worse over time.
